text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, can you tell me when the weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm started, and did it come on suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. To narrow down the cause, is the weakness and numbness confined to specific nerve distributions, or is it generalized throughout the entire arm? Also, have you noticed any similar symptoms in your legs or other parts of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness in the right arm. I also have Decreased sensation in the right arm, Dull aching and burning pain in the right arm, Significant weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: I hear your reports of dull aching and burning pain alongside the significant weight loss. Given your history of diabetes and heavy smoking, I need to rule out a space-occupying lesion; do you have any difficulty breathing, coughing up blood, or pain in your shoulder or chest?
